skills.skill: Compare and order decimal numbers up to hundredths
Round a decimal number to the nearest tenth

misconceptions.pattern: Thinks a decimal with more digits is larger (e.g. 2.47 > 2.5 because 47 > 5), comparing the fractional part as a whole number instead of place by place.
Drops the hundredths digit instead of rounding to the nearest tenth (e.g. 2.47 answered 2.4 rather than 2.5).

strategies.intent: Give both numbers the same number of decimal places (pad with a zero), then compare place by place from the largest place down.
Look at the hundredths digit: 5 or more rounds the tenth up, less than 5 keeps it; then drop the hundredths.
